title: the queue's residue line becomes a gate: an inline code span is a token quoted as DATA, and blanking it clears the standing counter-example

parameters.corpus: TASKS.md, every revision reachable from the baselineRef
parameters.predicate: a row whose leading verdict's SENSE differs from a whole-row scan for an unqualified closing word, with struck spans and inline code spans blanked
parameters.blankedSpans: single- and double-backticked inline code, on one line
parameters.note: no wall-clock timing and no step counter is emitted; the only non-integer is the false-positive rate, an exact quotient rendered at nine significant digits

T-111.reason: `**ANSWERED by C-0053**` in mid-cell prose while the row leads with `TODO`; the row was later rewritten and the clause is gone

T-183.reason: *RESOLVED* in ITALICS, quoting what another document said, while the row led with `TODO`; backticking it is the corpus's own idiom for a quoted token and falsifies nothing

T-231.reason: *the honeycomb station lattice was ANSWERED by C-0141* -- the shape `CLAUDE.md` records verbatim, whose prescribed repair is to lower-case the word

T-261.reason: its own TITLE read *a challenge the corpus has since ANSWERED*; lower-cased in the `P-30` document repair, and its three quoted status words are backticked and therefore blanked

T-268.reason: *`CH-0207` **CLOSED and REPAIRED*** (a challenge) and *`P1` was found ALREADY DISCHARGED* (a deliverable), both lower-cased in the `P-30` document repair

T-272.reason: *`P2` is DISCHARGED over the whole corpus* (a deliverable), lower-cased in the `P-30` document repair

T-280.reason: *Candidate 1 ... is **DONE*** (a candidate of a remedy), lower-cased in the `P-30` document repair

removalsAndWhyEachIsATrueNegative.T-256: the whole firing is a verbatim quotation of a tool's own output line, `line 965 STALE-OPEN CH-0187 CLOSED`, inside backticks -- quoted data, and the removal is a TRUE negative
removalsAndWhyEachIsATrueNegative.T-261: its acceptance criterion quotes `ANSWERED`, `UPHELD` and `RESOLVED` as DATA; this is the standing counter-example `P-30` left the line advisory for, and the removal is what makes the gate buyable

verdict.whereItIsWired: inside tools/check-queue-vocabulary.py, which tools/verify.sh already runs -- so NOTHING new is wired and what grew is the coverage of what is wired (C-0178's own shape)
verdict.bothReadingsBecauseThisRowIsInsideItsOwn: this task's row and its measurement live in TASKS.md, which is the corpus the residue measures; the reading at the baselineRef is the file BEFORE this iteration's edits and the working-tree reading is AFTER them

whatTheFirstRunFound: the blanking applied to the VERDICT as well as the scan failed nothing, because no fixture had a code span in FRONT of a verdict -- and that is the UNSAFE direction: blanking a leading code span lets the bold run behind it become the cell's leading run, MANUFACTURING a closing verdict in a cell that has none, so an open row would read closed

the refusal's own words were asserted nowhere, so a message stripped to `RESIDUE T-1 'TODO' CLOSED` failed nothing -- and this predicate has TWO repairs, lower-casing and backticking, of which only the second serves T-261
mutation.andAThirdDefectInTheHARNESS: the first harness copied tools/ FLAT, so the gate resolved its queue as /tmp/TASKS.md and every corpus test failed identically -- 12 mutations, 12 survivors. The layout is now <tmp>/tools/*.py beside <tmp>/TASKS.md, and the baseline failures of an UNMUTATED copy are measured and subtracted
